dedupe_keys.name: 自然災害による農水産業関係被害状況 disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 自然災害による農水産業関係被害状況 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 農産物（水稲、野菜、果樹、飼料作物、花き、畜産など）、農業施設（農地、農道など）、水産関係施設（漁船、養殖筏など）、漁港施設の被害状況. Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 災害情報. It offers 16 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
